column1: # Curated, growing list of "we know for a fact hipCUB already contains this
# specific upstream change" fingerprints. Each row maps a fixed-string code
# pattern to the CCCL tag it was introduced in. cccl-version-delta.sh greps
# hipCUB's tree at --base for each pattern (no network/remote needed) and
# reports the highest tag whose fingerprint is already present. That is
# Signal C, a local-only check for or against Signal D
# Empty so far: no fingerprint has been verified for hipCUB yet. Add a row
# whenever a sync finds hipCUB's tree already contains an upstream change
# from a tag newer than what Signals A/D report. Pick a pattern from the
# hipCUB side (usually backend/rocprim/), since backend/cub/ only forwards
# to whatever CCCL it is built against.
# Format: tab-separated, comments start with '#', blank lines ignored.
